tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ma drug cu'i gtor chog bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bha was stong par sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yaṃ oṃ/ a i ṛ u l̥/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā/ oṃ aṃ badzra rdo rje zla ba/ tsand+ra sarba dharma su bi shuddha swa bhā wa chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin/ chos rnams thams cad rnam par sbyongs sarba dharmānra bi shodha ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūrya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharmānra pra bo dha rdo rje nyi ma chos thams cad rab tu rtogs par byed/ chos thams cad rab tu rtogs par gyis ya swā hā/ oṃ rdo rje'i me hūm̐ badzra a na la chos thams cad rab tu 'bar bar byed pa sarba dharm+ma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmānra/ chos rnams thams cad rab tu 'bar bar gyisapra dī pā ya swā hā/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharm+ma badzra a mṛ ta ka ra/ chos thams cad rdo rje bdud rtsir byed pa/ sarba dharmānra badzra a mṛ taṃ chos rnams thams cad rdo rje bdud rtsir mdzod mdzod/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdapal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje 'jigs byed/ shrī kā la tsakra badzra bhai ra wa aṣṇī gtsug tor ṣa sumbha ni sumbha/ gnod mdzes nges par gnod mdzes/ bighnānta ka bgegs mthar byed/ ni la daṇṭa/ dbyug pa sngon po/ pradzñānta ka shes rab mthar byed/ ṭakki rā dza/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/padmānta ka padma mthar byed/ a tsa la/ mi g.yo ba/ ya mānta ka gshin rje mthar byed/ mahā ba le bhyaḥ stobs po che rnams/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/ gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me akṣa tanta ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/

'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ā kā sha nam mkha'/ wā yu rlung / te dza/ me/ u da ka chu/ pritha wī sa'i/ sā dhi te bhyaḥ grub pa rnams la/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/ gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me akṣa tanta ma nyams pa bdi bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ brahma tshangs pa/ biṣṇu khyab 'jug nair ri tya/ bden bral/ wā yu rlung / ya ma gshin rje/ agni me/ sa mu dre rgya mtsho/ shwarend+ra dbang phyug dbang po/ yakṣe bhyaḥ gnod sbyin rnams/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/

gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me akṣa tanta ma nyams pa bdi bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrā hu/ sgra gcan/ kā lāgni/ dus kyi me/ tsand+ra/ zla ba/ sūrya/ nyi ma/ bu dha/ lhag pa/ maṅga la/ bkra shis/ shu kra/ dkar po/ bṛ haspa ti phur pu/ ke tu mjug ring / sha ni bhyaḥ dal 'gro rnams/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/ gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me akṣa tanta ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dza ya rgyal ba/

bi dza ya rnam rgyal/ padma pad ma/ karko ṭa ka stobs kyi rgyu/ bā su ki nor rgyas/ shaṃ kha pā la/ dung skyong / ku li ka rigs ldan/ a nanta mtha' yas/ takṣa ka 'jog po/ ma hā padme bhyaḥ padma chen po rnams/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/ gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me/ akṣa tanta ma nyams pa bdi bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ be tā ḍa/ ro langs/ b-i kṛ ta mu kha/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal shwa/ khyi/ kā ka bya rog sū ka ra phag ghṛ dhra/ bya rgod/ bya ghra/ stag u lū ka 'ug pa/ dzambhu ka ce spyang / ga ru ḍa mu khe bhyaḥ khyung gi gdong can rnams/ sa pa ri wā re/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ i damba ling gtor ma 'di/ gandham dri/ puṣpan me tog dhū pan bdug pa/ dī paṃ sgron me/ akṣa tanta ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi/ dā ma he/ te tsā ga tya sa pa ri wā ra de rnams kyang myur du byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ i dam ba liṃ gtor ma 'di/ gṛhṇantu zung mdzod/ kha dantu bza' bar mdzod/ pi wantu/ btung bar mdzod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ santṛtpa yang dag par tshim par/ sarba satwa nāṃ sems can thams cad la/ shāntiṃ zhi ba/ puṣṭiṃ rgyas pa/ rakṣa bsrung ba/ ba ra ṇa skyabs pa/ guptiṅkurbantu sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyis/ swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyis 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud/ /gtsug tor gnod mdzes ngas gnod mdzes/ /bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug pa sngo/ /shes rab mthar byed 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /padma mthar byed mi g.yo ba/ /gshin rje mthar byed stobs chen rnams/ /nam mkha' rlung me chu dang ni/ /sa yi zad par grub pa rnams/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung / /gshin rje me dang rgya mtsho dang / /dbang phyug dbang po gnod sbyin rnams/ /sgra gcan dus me zla nyi ma/ /lhag pa bkra shis pa sangs dang / /phur bu mjug ring spen pa rnams/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal pad stobs rgyu/ /nor rgyas dung skyong rigs ldan dang / mtha' yas 'jog po pad chen rnams/ /ro langs rnam par 'gyur zhal khyi/ /bya rog phag dang bya rgod stag /'ug pa ce spyang khyung gdong rnams/ /'khor dang bcas la gtor ma dri/ /me tog bdug pa sgron me dang / /ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyis/ /'khor bcas de rnams myur byon nas/ /gtor ma 'di ni gzung bar mdzod/ /gsol bar mdzod cig btung bar mdzod/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang dag tshim/ /sems can kun la zhi ba dang / /rgyas dang bsrung dang skyabs pa dang / /sba ba mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ sarba dzñā shā lu paṇḍi ta dharma pā la bha tre ṇa ā dzña nanda puṇye na li khaṃ taṃ/
